description: The plot illustrates the relationship between iteration number and loss for three different configurations of SepLLM. The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration” and is linear, ranging from approximately 95000 to 125000 with tick labels spaced every 10000 units. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and is linear, ranging from 2.0 to 3.0 with tick labels spaced every 0.2 units. A magenta line, labeled “SepLLM (n=64, larger lr)”, begins at approximately 2.95 at an iteration of 95000 and decreases to approximately 2.22 at an iteration of 125000, with a steep decline between 95000 and 105000. A dark blue line, labeled “SepLLM (n=128)”, begins at approximately 2.95 at an iteration of 95000 and decreases to approximately 2.25 at an iteration of 125000, with a similar decline between 95000 and 105000. An orange line, labeled “SepLLM (n=64)”, begins at approximately 2.95 at an iteration of 95000 and decreases to approximately 2.26 at an iteration of 125000, also with a steep decline between 95000 and 105000. A red dashed line is present at a y-value of 2.2, extending horizontally across the entire plot.
